subject: Next steps — Private/VPC architecture review & slot selection

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@brightbridgehealth.com>, Elena Surov <elena.surov@brightbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — Private/VPC architecture review & slot selection

Hi Rajiv / Elena,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You have a hybrid environment with EKS on-prem and a VPC in us-east-1; primary concern is data residency and KMS/HSM integration.
- Goal for next meeting: 60–90 minute architecture review (network, identity & key management, data flow, and ops/runbook).
- We recommend inviting your infra lead + network/security engineer so we can map firewalls and IP allowlists during the call.

Proposed slots (all times in US/Pacific):
1) Thu Apr 22 — 09:00–10:30 PDT
2) Fri Apr 23 — 11:00–12:30 PDT
3) Mon Apr 26 — 14:00–15:30 PDT

Please pick whichever works best (or propose alternatives). I created a quick poll here to make selection easier: https://forms.gle/privdeploy-slot-poll-9xY

Proposed agenda (attached):
- 0–10m: Introductions & objectives
- 10–35m: Network topology & private connectivity options (Direct Connect / VPN / Transit)
- 35–60m: Key management / encryption at rest & in transit (KMS/HSM), logs & audit paths
- 60–80m: Deployment options & fallback policies (hosted vs. private variants)
- 80–90m: Action items and next steps

Helpful pre-reads attached: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today's call) and proposed-arch-agenda.md. 

If you confirm a slot, Ben (SE) will lead the architecture run-through. Connor will cover procurement/contract questions if they come up.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

—
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
[Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: proposed-arch-agenda.md (MD, 3KB)]

Subject: Re: Next steps — Private/VPC architecture review & slot selection

Thanks Naomi — useful recap. Elena (cc'd) is our infra lead and will join. 

The Friday Apr 23 11:00–12:30 PDT slot should work for our side (that's 14:00–15:30 EDT for us). Can you confirm if 90 minutes is OK? We want to walk through our on-prem network diagram and a couple of RFCs around ingress egress policies. Also, two quick items to prep for the call: 

- Can you share the IP ranges / NAT egress addresses Redwood uses so our security team can pre-check firewall rules?
- We need to understand what level of VPN (site-to-site IPsec) you support and whether there are examples of Direct Connect/Partner connectivity.

Rajiv — Friday works; we'll reserve 90 minutes to make sure we cover the topology and runbook items.

Quick answers to your prep items: 
- I'll have our network document with public egress / NAT ranges ready for the call; attaching a short IP-range stub before the meeting is fine.
- We support site-to-site IPsec and have partner Direct Connect playbooks; Ben will walk through reference topologies and examples.

Ben — can you prepare a simple 15–20 minute deep-dive portion on connectivity options and list of IP ranges we should share publicly? Also please attach an initial architecture diagram we can iterate on.

If you prefer, we can convert the calendar invite to a 2-hour block instead of 90 minutes — tell me if you'd like the extra buffer.

Best,
Naomi

Thanks Naomi — I'll lead the connectivity and KMS segments. I've attached a first-pass diagram (arch-diagram-v1.png) and a short checklist of items we'll need from BrightBridge:

- Border NAT / egress IP ranges (for allowlist)
- VPN endpoint public IP + ASN if using BGP
- Migrations windows and any blackout periods
I'll also include a slide with the supported Direct Connect/partner reference architecture and the minimal firewall ports we typically need.

See attachment: arch-diagram-v1.png (PNG, 420KB)

I'll join the invite as presenter; Naomi, feel free to convert to 2 hours if Rajiv wants buffer.
